en.p: There are five points in the coordinate plane:

For a point $\mathrm{P}$ moving on the sides of triangle $\mathrm{AOB}$ and a point $\mathrm{Q}$ moving on the sides of triangle $\mathrm{CDB}$, let $M$ and $m$ be the maximum and minimum values of $\left|\overrightarrow{\mathrm{PQ}}+\overrightarrow{\mathrm{OE}}\right|^{2}$, respectively. Find the value of $M+m$. (Here $\mathrm{O}$ is the origin.) [4 points]
